1.why: All nine screens are static with no moving images or pop-ups, though the ever-present monospace 'Logs' panel adds some avoidable visual clutter.

2.why: Primary actions are solid dark-blue buttons and 'Next:' hints are highlighted boxes with clear headings, but key secondary items like 'Forgot password?' are only small text links.

3.why: Each screen presents a single task with one labeled field and one dominant button, so the needed element is quick to locate.

4.why: Steps are numbered, shown one at a time with a progress bar, and password rules are listed on-screen exactly when needed, so little must be memorized.

5.why: No 'remember me' checkbox, password-manager integration, or autofill hint is visible on any screen.

6.why: Pages repeat identical layouts (the sign-in and confirmation screens appear twice unchanged), aiding recognition, but no saved or prefilled user items are shown.

7.why: All copy is short and plain, e.g., 'Step 1: Tell us the email address or patient reference connected to your account.'

8.why: No error message appears in any of the nine screenshots, so this claim cannot be confirmed or denied from what is shown.

9.why: Step descriptions and 'Next:' hints explain what to do, but fields show no concrete input examples or placeholders (e.g., no sample email or code format).

10.why: Each screen offers at most two clearly differentiated actions (e.g., 'Check code' vs 'Pause and return later'), though no face-login option exists.

11.why: No screen presents more than two buttons plus one text link, keeping simultaneous choices minimal.

12.why: 'Next:' boxes preview outcomes and a green 'Privacy conditions accepted' banner confirms completion, but password-save success appears only in the simulated Logs line, not in the page itself.

13.why: Every page carries a 'Need help?' sidebar with short tips ('It is okay to pause', 'Stay safe') plus a persistent 'Help and safe advice' header link.

14.why: 'Back to sign in' links and 'Pause and return later' buttons suggest forgiving navigation, but no wrong-entry or retry scenario is actually demonstrated.

15.why: Header, sidebar, button styles, progress bar, and overall layout are identical across all nine steps, supporting learning through consistency.
